text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah♪ This restaurant...
feels like something straight out of a movie.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of menu they have.
Maybe some stylish Mediterranean dishes... Hehe.
To think I'd find such a wonderful restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Today's lunch is settled, we're eating here—
Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your many years of patronage"...
No way...!

Upon realizing the restaurant she was interested in
was permanently closed, Buena Vista
was overcome with sadness...
